summary: Methanex Corporation filed a Form 6-K on July 15, 2026, announcing that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of US$0.185 per share, payable on September 30, 2026, to shareholders of record on September 16, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration and not a special situation. There are no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other corporate-event terms. The filing is a standard periodic disclosure by a foreign private issuer.
